subject: c-cont
title: C.CONT.------C.ACT.
description: Chart on book p. 124 (AE(PD)-12). C-CONT (composite continuance) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; C-ACT (composite activism) is the partner. From the subject: TR (transformation). From TR: SOC-RT (social reality) and INFO-DY (information dynamics). From INFO-DY: EXT-INFO-B and POST (postulation). From EXT-INFO-B: TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". PR-TRS is on a dotted line from EXT-INFO-B. AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) is on a dotted line from POST. From PR-TRS: EXT-FT (extended functionalism). From AFL-DY: AFI (affinity insight).
